1 import Mathlib
2 
3 /-! The cap budgets and gate selection in PRISM_CAP_RULE.md; no geometric net is assumed. -/
4 
5 namespace SixVertexUnfolding.Prism
6 
7 open Real
8 
9 /-- At a degree-three source, the wider-angle deficit is a cap-curvature deficit. -/
10 theorem cap_identity {lam ρ ν kp K : ℝ}
11     (source_sum : lam + ρ + ν = 2 * π - kp) :
12     2 * lam + ν - 2 * π - K = lam - ρ - (kp + K) := by
13   linarith
14 
15 /-- A cap sum of at least pi supplies both wider Case A angle bounds. -/
16 theorem cap_wider_bounds {lam ρ ν kp K : ℝ}
17     (source_sum : lam + ρ + ν = 2 * π - kp)
18     (left_pos : 0 < lam) (left_lt : lam < π)
19     (right_pos : 0 < ρ) (right_lt : ρ < π)
20     (cap_high : π ≤ kp + K) :
21     lam < (π + (π - ν + K)) / 2 ∧ ρ < (π + (π - ν + K)) / 2 := by
22   constructor <;> linarith
23 
24 /-- The two-cap decision includes the equality cases in the first branch. -/
25 theorem cap_cases {lower upper : ℝ} (total : lower + upper = 4 * π) :
26     (π ≤ lower ∧ π ≤ upper) ∨
27     (3 * π < lower ∧ upper < π) ∨
28     (3 * π < upper ∧ lower < π) := by
29   by_cases lower_high : π ≤ lower
30   · by_cases upper_high : π ≤ upper
31     · exact Or.inl ⟨lower_high, upper_high⟩
32     · exact Or.inr (Or.inl ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩)
33   · exact Or.inr (Or.inr ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩)
34 
35 /-- A cap below pi has every positive constituent below pi. -/
36 theorem low_cap_vertices {a b c : ℝ}
37     (a_pos : 0 < a) (b_pos : 0 < b) (c_pos : 0 < c)
38     (cap_low : a + b + c < π) : a < π ∧ b < π ∧ c < π := by
39   exact ⟨by linarith, by linarith, by linarith⟩
40 
41 /-- The low-end branch of a high cap supplies both gates for Switch 2. -/
42 theorem high_cap_forces_gates {k0 k1 k2 : ℝ}
43     (cap_high : 3 * π < k0 + k1 + k2)
44     (vertex_bound : k1 < 2 * π) (end_low : k2 < π) :
45     π < k0 + k2 ∧ 2 * π < k0 + k1 := by
46   exact ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
47 
48 /-- The two middle angles used by Switch 2 cannot both be obtuse. -/
49 theorem one_middle_angle_nonobtuse {a b c : ℝ}
50     (triangle_sum : a + b + c = π) (third_pos : 0 < c) :
51     a ≤ π / 2 ∨ b ≤ π / 2 := by
52   by_cases first : a ≤ π / 2
53   · exact Or.inl first
54   · exact Or.inr (by linarith)
55 
56 /-- One of the two views of the fallback has central angle at least pi. -/
57 theorem one_view_at_least_pi {lower upper : ℝ}
58     (view_sum : lower + upper = 2 * π) : π ≤ lower ∨ π ≤ upper := by
59   by_cases first : π ≤ lower
60   · exact Or.inl first
61   · exact Or.inr (by linarith)
62 
63 end SixVertexUnfolding.Prism
